project.name: iGaming Platform
project.description: SmartBet.guru SaaS platform monorepo - Fail-Fast, Health Standardization & K8s Probes

tasks.title: [core] Implement EmergencyIncidentTracker, Actuator & LivenessState.BROKEN
tasks.description: Introduce Spring Actuator Liveness/Readiness, EmergencyIncidentTracker, FatalIncidentBanner and integrate with AbstractBaseBookmakerService and AbstractApiErrorTracker.

tasks.title: [aggregator-ingestion] Kafka Consumer Fail-Fast and Actuator Liveness Probe
tasks.description: Add Actuator, wrap Kafka consumers with backoff and deadlock detection, publish LivenessState.BROKEN if Kafka is unreachable > 3 minutes, add probes to K8s.

tasks.title: [aggregator-surebet] Surebet Engine In-Memory Stall Detector & DB Deadlock Fail-Fast
tasks.description: Add heartbeat timestamp on SurebetDetectorService loop. If 60s pass with incoming odds but 0 evaluations, declare incident. Add liveness probes.

tasks.title: [aggregator-odds-sync] Odds Synchronization & Eviction Health Checks
tasks.description: Integrate Actuator and check Redis/DB connectivity. If odds sync thread hangs, degrade liveness.

tasks.title: [aggregator-api] REST Gateway Actuator, Connection Pool Health & Probes
tasks.description: Add Actuator, HikariCP pool health indicators, and configure readiness probes to refuse traffic if pool is exhausted.

tasks.title: [igaming-portal] User Gateway Actuator, DB Resilience & Feed Cache Health
tasks.description: Add spring-boot-starter-actuator to pom.xml, configure DataSourceHealthIndicator, add liveness & readiness probes in K8s.

tasks.title: [igaming-bot] Telegram Bot Long Polling Dead-Man-Switch & Fail-Fast
tasks.description: Monitor Telegram Long Polling session. If updates stop for > 5 minutes, trigger LivenessState.BROKEN and restart pod.

tasks.title: [service-proxy-backend] Proxy Pool Zero-Node Alarm & Infra Operator Health
tasks.description: Signal emergency when active proxy nodes drop to 0. Add Actuator health check.

tasks.title: [capture] SofaScore & LiveResult Anti-Bot Fail-Fast & Parser Degradation
tasks.description: If Cloudflare 403 or HTML parser fails for 10 consecutive cycles, declare LivenessState.BROKEN.

tasks.title: [winline] Winline SAPI Timeout, Cloudflare Turnstile & K8s Probes
tasks.description: Track SAPI 45s timeouts and Turnstile challenges. 3 consecutive failures -> LivenessState.BROKEN. Add probes to winline.ru.yaml.

tasks.title: [fonbet] Fonbet (RU/BY/KZ) WebSocket Integrity & Line Packet Deserialization Fail-Fast
tasks.description: Detect packet version changes and WebSocket frame drops. 3 failures -> emergency restart. Update fon.bet.yaml, fonbet.by.yaml, fonbet.kz.yaml.

tasks.title: [betb2b] BetB2B Family (1xbet, 1xbit, 22bet, melbet, megapari) 406 & Kafka Timeout Fail-Fast
tasks.description: Catch 406 NotAcceptable, No route to host, and Kafka Expiring records timeout. Trigger LivenessState.BROKEN after 3 cycles. Update 11 K8s manifests.
